desc: Implement the complete solution with input parsing, final-position simulation, inclusive segment collection, per-line interval merging, and per-house binary-search coverage counting.

Validate edge cases: houses exactly at segment endpoints, overlapping or adjacent intervals on the same line, houses at horizontal/vertical intersections, large coordinates, and many segments with no houses.
If the per-line approach has performance or memory issues, switch to a sweep-line or inclusion-exclusion fallback.
